name: Countrywood Shopping Center
summary: Countrywood Shopping Center is Walnut Creek's premier neighborhood shopping destination, conveniently located at Treat Boulevard and Bancroft Road. Anchored by Safeway, CVS/Pharmacy, and McCaulou's Department Store, this vibrant center offers everything from grocery shopping to popular dining options like Starbucks, Panera Bread, and Genova Delicatessen.
demographics: Countrywood Shopping Center serves the affluent residential communities of Walnut Creek, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area consists of established neighborhoods with a mix of young families, working professionals aged 30-55, and active retirees who value convenience and quality. Shoppers typically have household incomes above the regional median and prioritize one-stop shopping for groceries, dining, and everyday services. The center draws regular weekly visitors for routine shopping needs, with strong foot traffic during morning coffee hours and lunch periods from nearby office workers and residents.
description: Countrywood Shopping Center stands as Walnut Creek's premier neighborhood shopping destination, strategically positioned at the highly visible corner of Treat Boulevard and Bancroft Road. This well-established community center serves as the retail heart of the surrounding residential neighborhoods, offering a carefully curated mix of essential services, dining favorites, and quality retailers all in one convenient location. Anchored by trusted names including Safeway supermarket, CVS/Pharmacy, and the beloved local McCaulou's Department Store, the center provides everything residents need for their daily lives. The diverse tenant roster includes popular dining destinations such as Starbucks Coffee, Noah's Bagels, Jamba Juice, Panera Bread, and Genova Delicatessen, creating a vibrant gathering place for the community. With its prime location on a major arterial road leading directly into established residential areas, Countrywood Shopping Center has earned its reputation as the go-to destination where shopping, dining, and services come together seamlessly, making it truly a one-stop shopping experience for Walnut Creek families.
